d.ko: Ragnarok: The New World is Gravity's officially licensed cross-platform MMORPG, reimagining RO's cute, classic Midgard with high-quality visuals and audio on PC and mobile. Choose 8 Classes, including the new Druid. Explore, tame MVPs as Mounts, trade freely, and customize 100+ looks with friends!

d.zh: 《Ragnarok: The New World》是一款由Gravity正版授权的旗舰级跨平台MMORPG。游戏延续RO经典Q萌画风，以高品质视听表现重塑米德加兹大陆，支持PC与移动端游玩。开服8大职业可选，全新职业「德鲁伊」首发登场！探索广阔世界，收服MVP作为坐骑，自由摆摊交易，上百种外观任你DIY。与伙伴在新世界重逢，一起开启全新的RO冒险！
